question.text: Choose the correct statement regarding the formation of carbocations A and B given :-

options.text: Carbocation B is more stable and formed relatively at faster rate
Carbocation A is more stable and formed relatively at slow rate
Carbocation B is more stable and formed relatively at slow rate
Carbocation A is more stable and formed relatively at faster rate

solution.text: This is more stable due to secondary cation formation and formed with faster rate due to low activation energy.
